initialExam.title: TSPSC Group 2 Services 2026
initialExam.description: TSPSC Group 2 exam for middle-level posts in Telangana government departments.
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: GS & General Abilities. Paper-II: Telangana History & Movement. Paper-III: Economy & Development.
initialExam.examPattern: Screening + Mains: 3 papers, 450 marks. 150Q each, 2.5 hours.
initialExam.jobRole: Tahsildar, Municipal Commissioner Gr-II, Sub-Registrar, and Group 2 posts
initialExam.careerGrowth: Tahsildar → RDO → Joint Collector through promotions.

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, State benefits
